issuesEn: Caret bug: untyped characters held their space at opacity 0, so the caret floated far from the text at the line end
Courier fallback mono and single-grey output
The third window's last line was still fading in on the final frame, so the shot never settled
Flat window chrome, a single-gradient background, and no sense of speed during flights
changesEn: Only typed characters are laid out, so the block caret hugs the text; the $ prompt is always shown
System mono stack (SF Mono/JetBrains Mono); output is colored by meaning (branch green, modified amber, untracked red, status codes green, URLs cyan)
Tightened timing: second flight 0.63–0.77, TYPE 0.455/0.79, output 0.016 per line with 0.03 duration; the third window finishes at 0.963 and holds

Glass chrome: hairline and lit top rim on the top layer, gradient body, an indigo ambient glow on the focused window; a dot-grid far layer with counter-parallax, vignette and grain; directional motion blur during flights from the camera's screen velocity
